page.overview:
Who is Katara Vala?

Katara Vala is a minor character who appears in Mortal Kombat 1, appearing in Johnny Cage's Chapter as a reskin of Havik. He serves as the titular main antagonist of the fictional film, Temple of Katara Vala and as such appears in the Treasure Chamber arena.

After being awaken by the Tomb Raider and Adam, Katara Vala scared Adam off as he falls into the mercury rivers below, killing him instantly. He attempts to kill the Tomb Raider as he tries to take the shield away, but the death of Adam angered the latter enough to start a fight between the two.

Katara Vala and the Tomb Raider would briefly fight, before he gets decapitated by his own shield at the hands of the Tomb Raider.
